cases.name: from-without-to
cases.description: from= and to= are used together or not at all

cases.name: unknown-date-locale
cases.description: A date locale nobody has translated

cases.name: step-not-a-step
cases.description: a step this notation cannot express is refused
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" order="sequential" step="fortnight"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: step-old-spelled-out-form
cases.description: the earlier prose form is gone: there is one notation, not two
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" order="sequential" step="15 minute"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: step-mixes-calendar-and-fixed
cases.description: a month plus fifteen days depends on which is applied first, so it is refused rather than guessed
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" order="sequential" step="1mo15d"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: step-repeats-a-unit
cases.description: a repeated unit is a typo; summing it would hide the typo instead of reporting it
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" order="sequential" step="1h30m1h"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: step-without-order-sequential
cases.description: nothing walks the range, so step= would be read by nobody

cases.name: weekdays-without-order-sequential
cases.description: the same for the filter: with no walk there is nothing to filter

cases.name: weekdays-unknown-name
cases.description: a weekday that does not exist is named rather than silently dropped
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" order="sequential" weekdays="mon..frr"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: weekdays-hyphen-is-not-a-range
cases.description: the range operator is .. everywhere in this language, so mon-fri is not a span
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" order="sequential" weekdays="mon-fri"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: weekdays-under-a-weekly-step
cases.description: a whole week always lands on the same weekday, so the filter would match every row or none
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" order="sequential" step="1w" weekdays="mon"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: weekdays-under-a-fourteen-day-step
cases.description: 14d fixes the weekday exactly as 2w does — the test is the step's LENGTH, not its spelling
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" order="sequential" step="14d" weekdays="mon"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: weekdays-under-a-calendar-step
cases.description: a calendar step fixes the weekday too
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" order="sequential" step="1mo" weekdays="mon"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: walked-from-alone-is-accepted
cases.description: from= with no end is an OPEN axis when the range is walked: no diagnostic at all
